# Rejourney Unity SDK 0.1.2

Bug fixes and performance improvements.

## Install

Download `co.rejourney.unity-0.1.2.tgz` below and choose **Window → Package Manager → + → Install package from tarball**, or add this line to `Packages/manifest.json`:

```json
"co.rejourney.unity": "https://github.com/rejourneyco/rejourney.git?path=/packages/unity#unity-v0.1.2"
```

Then follow the [Unity SDK guide](https://rejourney.co/docs/unity/overview). The `.sha256` file lets you verify the download.
